coverage.notes: SEL: ISBE's revised SEL Standards (July 2026 edition; 5 goals, 15 indicators, grade-banded) apply beginning the 2026-27 school year; the original 2005 standards had 3 goals and 10 standards. Portrait of a Graduate: SECONDARY SOURCE ONLY - a local news report (Oak Park) quoting an ISBE spokesperson that districts decide on local portraits; a 2025 research report also lists Illinois as optional/district-led. No ISBE document stating this was found. Reviewer: confirm with ISBE before verifying the POG status.

frameworks.name: Illinois Social and Emotional Learning Standards (July 2026 revision)
frameworks.notes: Read from ISBE's 'Social and Emotional Learning Standards' PDF dated July 2026 (isbe.net/Documents/SEL-Standards-Chart.pdf). Five goals named after the CASEL competencies; 15 indicators (1A-5C), each with benchmarks for K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-10 and 11-12. ISBE's own front-page notice says indicators 2B and 2C were mistakenly printed with the text of 1B and 1C; the intended wording (used here) will be corrected through rulemaking in 2026-27. Titles are short paraphrases. Adoption year deliberately left blank: confirm the rule's effective date with ISBE.

items.title: Awareness of one's emotions and their influence on behavior
items.summary: Recognize and understand one's emotions and how they shape behavior.

items.title: Awareness of personal and collective identity
items.summary: Understand identity, strengths, areas for growth, aspirations, and cultural and linguistic assets.

items.title: How external influences shape personal and academic goals
items.summary: Understand how culture, family and community deepen one's grasp of personal and academic goals.

items.title: Manage emotions, thoughts and behaviors effectively
items.summary: Use strategies to manage emotions, thoughts and behavior.

items.title: Adapt, persevere and build resilience
items.summary: Use effective strategies to adapt, persevere and build resilience (intended wording; see framework notes).

items.title: Apply problem solving to personal and academic goals
items.summary: Use problem-solving skills and strategies to achieve personal and academic goals (intended wording; see framework notes).

items.title: Recognize that others think and feel differently
items.summary: Understand that others may have similar or different thoughts and feelings based on experience, ability, community and culture.

items.title: Interact and communicate effectively with others
items.summary: Use a range of skills to interact and communicate well in social and academic settings.

items.title: Awareness of others' emotions, perspectives and backgrounds
items.summary: Show awareness of others' emotions, perspectives, backgrounds, identities, languages, abilities and cultures.

items.title: Value similarities and differences to build relationships
items.summary: Recognize, value and affirm individual and group similarities and differences to strengthen relationships in communities.

items.title: Communicate and listen across diverse perspectives
items.summary: Communicate and listen effectively with people of diverse perspectives, cultures, languages and abilities to build relationships.

items.title: Prevent, manage and resolve conflicts
items.summary: Prevent, manage and resolve conflicts by interacting productively with others.

items.title: Question, investigate and seek understanding
items.summary: Engage in questioning and investigating a topic or problem to build knowledge and solve problems.

items.title: Weigh sources and perspectives to make informed decisions
items.summary: Consider multiple sources of information and diverse perspectives, and the impact of decisions on self and others.

items.title: Make thoughtful, safe, inclusive decisions
items.summary: Make thoughtful, safe and inclusive choices in academic, social and digital environments.
